proposals.name: Company
proposals.description: An organization or subsidiary that acts as the buyer in the purchasing process.

proposals.name: Subsidiary
proposals.description: A company that is owned or controlled by another company.

proposals.name: Vendor
proposals.description: An external entity that supplies goods or services to the company.

proposals.name: InternalDepartment
proposals.description: A department within the company that requires purchased goods or services.

proposals.name: Warehouse
proposals.description: A physical location where goods are delivered and stored.

proposals.name: Goods
proposals.description: Physical items or products purchased from a vendor.

proposals.name: PurchaseOrder
proposals.description: A document issued by a buyer to a seller indicating types, quantities, and agreed prices for products or services.

proposals.name: StandardPurchaseOrder
proposals.description: A standard type of purchase order used for one-off purchases.

proposals.name: FrameworkPurchaseOrder
proposals.description: A purchase order that supports recurring invoices over a period of time.

proposals.name: ECPurchaseOrder
proposals.description: A purchase order that includes an SRM subprocess before or around item creation.

proposals.name: PurchaseOrderItem
proposals.description: An individual line item within a purchase order.

proposals.name: PurchaseRequisition
proposals.description: An internal document that defines the need for a purchase before an order is created.

proposals.name: OrderConfirmation
proposals.description: A document or communication from a vendor confirming the receipt and acceptance of a purchase order.

proposals.name: ServiceEntrySheet
proposals.description: A document recording service-related steps or work performed.

proposals.name: Invoice
proposals.description: A document requesting payment for goods or services provided.

proposals.name: VendorInvoice
proposals.description: An invoice created and sent by a vendor.

proposals.name: RecurringInvoice
proposals.description: An invoice that occurs repeatedly over a period of time, typically supported by a framework order.

proposals.name: Receipt
proposals.description: A document acknowledging that goods or services have been received.

proposals.name: VendorDebitMemo
proposals.description: A document issued by a vendor to adjust the amount owed.

proposals.name: Consignment
proposals.description: A business arrangement where goods are stored at the buyer's site but owned by the vendor until consumed.

proposals.name: ProcessVariant
proposals.description: A specific path or sequence of activities followed in the purchasing process.

proposals.name: Resource
proposals.description: An entity, either human or automated, that executes or records activities.

proposals.name: BusinessActivity
proposals.description: An activity or event recorded in the business process.

proposals.name: PurchaseOrderProcessing
proposals.description: The activity of processing a purchase order, which can include various changes and approvals.

proposals.name: PurchaseOrderItemCreation
proposals.description: The activity of creating a purchase order item.

proposals.name: PurchaseRequisitionCreation
proposals.description: The activity of creating a purchase requisition.

proposals.name: OrderConfirmationRecording
proposals.description: The activity of recording an order confirmation.

proposals.name: ServiceEntrySheetRecording
proposals.description: The activity of recording a service entry sheet.

proposals.name: GoodsReceipt
proposals.description: The activity of recording the receipt of goods.

proposals.name: GoodsReceiptCancellation
proposals.description: The activity of cancelling a previously recorded goods receipt.

proposals.name: InvoiceCreation
proposals.description: The activity of creating an invoice.

proposals.name: VendorInvoiceCreation
proposals.description: The activity of a vendor creating an invoice.

proposals.name: InvoiceReceipt
proposals.description: The activity of recording the receipt of an invoice.

proposals.name: InvoiceHandling
proposals.description: The activity of processing or handling an invoice.

proposals.name: InvoiceClearance
proposals.description: The activity of clearing an invoice for payment.

proposals.name: Payment
proposals.description: The activity of paying for goods or services.

proposals.name: Consumption
proposals.description: The activity of consuming goods, particularly in a consignment arrangement.

proposals.name: Production
proposals.description: The activity of using goods in manufacturing or production.

proposals.name: SRMActivity
proposals.description: An activity associated with Supplier Relationship Management.

proposals.name: PaymentBlockCreation
proposals.description: The activity of creating a payment block on an invoice.

proposals.name: PaymentBlockRemoval
proposals.description: The activity of removing a payment block from an invoice.

proposals.name: PaymentBlocking
proposals.description: The activity of blocking a payment, typically due to early invoice receipt.

proposals.name: PriceChange
proposals.description: The activity of changing the price of an item.

proposals.name: QuantityChange
proposals.description: The activity of changing the quantity of an item.

proposals.name: DeliveryIndicatorChange
proposals.description: The activity of changing the delivery indicator on an item.

proposals.name: PurchaseOrderApprovalChange
proposals.description: The activity of changing the approval status of a purchase order.

proposals.name: Cancellation
proposals.description: The activity of cancelling an order or item.

proposals.name: ItemDeletion
proposals.description: The activity of deleting an item.

proposals.name: Release
proposals.description: The activity of releasing an order or item.

proposals.name: Reactivation
proposals.description: The activity of reactivating a deleted or cancelled item.

proposals.name: PurchaseOrderItemChange
proposals.description: The activity of making changes to a purchase order item.

proposals.name: Approval
proposals.description: The activity of approving a document or decision.

proposals.name: BlockCreation
proposals.description: The activity of creating a block state.

proposals.name: PaymentBlockState
proposals.description: The state of an invoice being blocked for payment.

proposals.name: BlockState
proposals.description: The state of being blocked.

proposals.name: ProcessDeviation
proposals.description: An apparent deviation from the standard process flow.

proposals.name: ComplianceViolation
proposals.description: An occurrence that violates compliance rules.

proposals.name: ApprovalAuthority
proposals.description: The rule or authority defining who can approve an activity.

proposals.name: ServiceLevelThreshold
proposals.description: A threshold defining expected performance or service levels.

proposals.name: InvoiceClearanceRule
proposals.description: A rule governing when an invoice can be cleared.

proposals.name: InvoiceMatchingProcedure
proposals.description: A procedure or rule for matching invoices against purchase orders and receipts.

proposals.name: OrderingRule
proposals.description: Rules governing ordering, cardinality, and exclusiveness.

proposals.name: PrecedenceRule
proposals.description: A rule defining the required order of activities.

proposals.name: EventualResponseRule
proposals.description: A rule defining that an activity must eventually be followed by another.

proposals.name: DocumentLinkage
proposals.description: An authoritative linkage between invoices and receipts.

proposals.name: SRMSubprocess
proposals.description: A Supplier Relationship Management subprocess.
